meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会作为写作搭档陪你写文章:一起搭文章大纲、检索资料并按格式加引用、重写开头 hook、逐段给反馈,同时尽量保留你自己的语气和风格。
howto.when: 写博客、深度文章或技术文档时可用;需要研究资料、改开头 hook 或逐段反馈时也会接管。

say.text: 帮我为这篇关于远程协作的文章搭一个大纲
say.note: 会先问受众、篇幅和风格,再给带研究待办的大纲

say.text: 这是我的开头,帮我改得更抓人
say.note: 会给出几个备选 hook 并说明各自为什么有效

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么重要」这一节,帮我看看
say.note: 会按清晰度、行文、证据、风格逐项反馈

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: it co-builds outlines, finds sources and formats citations, rewrites hooks, and reviews each section while preserving your voice and tone.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, or technical docs, or when you need research, a stronger hook, or section-by-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me outline an article about remote collaboration.
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length, and style, then outlines.

say_en.text: Here's my opening. Make the hook more compelling.
say_en.note: You get several hook options with reasons why each works.

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it.
say_en.note: Feedback covers clarity, flow, evidence, and style.
